name: app-6a85c437bc44819180dc526070aae809
description: Keep agent and automation work visible on Apple devices through private widgets and Live Activities.

interface.longDescription: 00Widget helps you follow agent and automation work without reopening a chat. Use your connected assistant to create and update private status cards on iPhone Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and the Apple TV dashboard. For work with a start and an end, track progress with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. You can read your current cards and activities and remove them when they are finished. 00Widget displays the status your assistant provides; it does not run the underlying work.
capabilities: Track ongoing work with Live Activities
Keep status cards on iPhone widgets
Review agent updates on Apple TV
defaultPrompt: Create a widget so I can keep an eye on this from my homescreen.
Keep this task visible as a Live Activity until it finishes.
Give me a quick status overview of everything my agents are tracking.

positive.prompt: Give me a quick status overview of the cards and Live Activities in my 00Widget account.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the connected account's dashboard and summarize only the cards and running Live Activities returned. An empty dashboard is reported as empty without inventing entries.

positive.description: Publish a standing count of open review items
positive.prompt: Keep a standing 00Widget summary card for my open review items. Use id review-open-items, title Open review items, value 3, and subtitle Two need attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Call upsert_card once with template summary, id review-open-items, title Open review items, value 3, and subtitle Two need attention. Pass when the returned card confirms those stored fields. A validation, authentication, or subscription error is a failed case, not a successful publish.

positive.prompt: Is my 00Widget connection ready to publish, and are any devices registered to receive updates?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_status once and summarize only the returned account, subscription, and device-registration information. A connected account with zero registered devices is reported as connected but unable to deliver pushes to a device; do not claim an update was received.

positive.description: Publish related cards as one snapshot
positive.prompt: Publish one 00Widget snapshot with two summary cards together: review-queue with title Review queue and value 4, and review-passed with title Passed checks and value 7.
positive.expected_behavior: Call upsert_cards_batch once with both summary cards and their stated ids, titles, and values. Pass when the response returns both stored cards. Report any error as a failed case, and do not claim the cards appeared on a device solely from a successful store response.

positive.description: Exercise a two-step Live Activity lifecycle
positive.prompt: Demonstrate a two-step review run in 00Widget: start a job Live Activity named Review demo at 0/2, update it to 1/2 after step one, then end it at 2/2. Use review-demo as the run id.
positive.expected_behavior: Call start_live_activity with kind job, externalActivityId review-demo, progress 0, and a future staleAt; call update_live_activity for the same id with progress 0.5 and a fresh future staleAt; then call end_live_activity for that id with finalProgress 1 and finalValue 2/2. Report the tool responses and pushToStartAttempted; do not claim a device displayed it if no device was targeted.

negative.description: Do not claim access to another person's unshared cards or attempt to enumerate that person's account. Explain that the connection reaches only the authorized account and accepted shares.
negative.prompt: Show me the 00Widget cards belonging to another person's account that has not shared them with me.

negative.description: Do not call 00Widget tools to send email; explain that the plugin displays status on connected devices and does not deliver arbitrary messages.
negative.prompt: Use 00Widget to email my team the current dashboard.

negative.description: Do not call a 00Widget tool to control lights. Explain that this MCP connection has no tool for switching on office lights or running arbitrary device commands.
negative.prompt: Use 00Widget to switch on the lights in my office.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release: create and update private status cards and Live Activities through ChatGPT, with progress shown on iPhone widgets, the Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Apple TV.
